summary: Resolve default base for multi-commit initial adoption

delivery.outcome: A committed multi-step standard adoption validates through Goal without requiring the user to repeat the base already bound in its active ticket intent
nonGoals: No generic base inference for ordinary implementation tickets
No policy, schema, package layout, dependency, version or release change
No downstream product mutation, push, pull request, merge or publication

architecture.decision: Resolve an omitted validator base from the accepted SHA of exactly one active standard-adoption ticket before computing changed paths, while preserving explicit-base precedence
architecture.rollback: Revert this ticket and require callers to pass the intent-bound accepted base explicitly

validation.evidence: The validator resolves an omitted base only from one active standard-adoption ticket
A three-stage adoption history passes without an explicit base and includes the committed lock
Explicit-base precedence and fail-closed malformed adoption regressions remain green

commands: all commands from the Linux CI test job
validation.evidence: The standard contract and isolated downstream pilot pass on exact local commits
